subject: Helio Health - request for 30% Hosted API concession on 12mo commit
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Rivera <michael.rivera@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Helio Health - ask: 30% concession on Hosted API for 12mo commit

Team — quick heads up on a tight approval ask from Helio. They’re proposing a 12-month committed usage contract (beginning Oct 1) and are pushing hard for a 30% off-list hosted API rate to make the economics work against a cloud vendor renewal.

Snapshot: Helio (series C, digital care platform) is offering us a 12-month committed spend of ~$1.2M net list (post-discount this is the ask), with a staged ramp (Q4 2026 to Q3 2027). They’ve refused our standard 20% "strategic" concession and are requesting 30% to match an incumbent pricing term tied to token-unit pricing + embedding volume.

Attachments: usage_forecast_helio_q4q5.csv, helio_commit_profile.xlsx, MA draft attached for context.

Asking: Ben needs an exec exception for >20% (30% requested) and signoff to lock commercial terms before their board meeting on 9/20. My read: high strategic value (large provider in NE US, potential reference + marketplace listing), but margin hit if we don’t structure protections.

Ben — can you confirm the proposed effective rate, expected net ARR, and whether we can get a mid-term price reopener tied to usage thresholds?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helio Health - ask: 30% concession on Hosted API for 12mo commit

Ben — thanks for the summary. Two quick points from deal desk:

1) We can approve up to 20% via delegated authority for a 12mo commit with standard legal protections. Anything beyond 20% requires Exec signoff and a clear loss-mitigation plan (usage gates, minimums, auto-scale caps, or a quarterly true-up).

2) Need concrete forecasts (token/embedding splits) and a rollback trigger: if they under-deliver by >25% of the forecast in any rolling quarter, we either reprice or terminate the discount for subsequent quarters.

Please share the forecast and the MA redlines; I’ll prepare a short memo for Evelyn summarizing margin impact. If you want a fast path, include a one-page mutual action plan and the revenue ops forecast so finance can model the hit.

-Karthik

Karthik — attaching the forecast and MA draft per your ask. Short answers inline below and in the attachments:

- Proposed effective discount: 30% off our hosted API token rates and 30% off embeddings for the committed volume tranche.
- Expected net ARR (post discount): ~$840k in year one, with a conservative ramp. Forecast file has month-by-month token estimates.
- Protection asks from our side proposed in the MA: quarterly true-up with minimum committed token volume, a three-month notice for any reprice, and an SLA credits cap baked into the SOW. We also propose a mid-term performance reopener at month 6 tied to usage band attainment.

Attachments included: helio_commit_profile.xlsx, usage_forecast_helio_q4q5.csv, helio_ma_draft_v3.pdf

Michael — I’m looping in Evelyn for exec consideration given ask >20%. Their board signs off next Monday; we need a decision before COB Friday (9/18) to get terms to them for signature.

Ben

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helio Health - ask: 30% concession on Hosted API for 12mo commit

Thanks for the clear packet — I reviewed the forecast and the MA draft. I’m authorizing an exception to our delegated 20% limit and approving the 30% hosted API and embeddings concession subject to the following conditions (please coordinate with Legal & Finance to lock these into the final SOW/MA):

1) Minimum committed spend: Helio must commit to the token/embedding minimums in the attached forecast; failure to meet 80% of the committed monthly volume for two consecutive quarters triggers a negotiated step-up of pricing for the remainder of the term.

2) Quarterly true-up and makewhole: Any shortfall in committed volume will be invoiced at the non-discounted rate for the shortfall, capped at 3 months of makewhole, after which the parties will revert to standard pricing.

3) Six-month performance reopener: At month six we will re-evaluate pricing bands — if usage materially exceeds forecast (>150%), we will discuss an upside rebate; if usage is materially below forecast (<60%), the discount may be rescinded for subsequent quarters.

4) Auto-scaling limits: Technical guardrails to prevent unbounded burst consumption outside the committed tranche. Engineering will add rate-limits to the Helio tenant until reverse-provisioning is formally approved.

5) Legal: No changes to our IP/indemnity clauses. Revenue ops to confirm ARR math and cadence of billing (monthly vs quarterly).

Ben — please ask Legal to incorporate the clauses and Finance to model the cashflow. Karthik / Mina, please annotate the deal in HubSpot and set the approval status to "Exec-approved (30% concession)" and route the final MA to me for signature if all checks pass.

Michael — happy to move forward at 30% with these guardrails. Ben will send the final MA and timelines; please aim to return signed docs by Friday EOD so we can start the onboarding cadence in October.

Thanks,
Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
